findings.description: Round 1: the guide and invocation.md did not say what a diagram link's title is, so an agent passing a click's tooltip with its marks as --presets looped on E_ALTERNATIVE_UNRESOLVED.
Round 1: a click's refusals named it by its tooltip marks, as the link '' or '⇉↳ ', with that as the reference.

Round 1: the corpus lacked fixtures for a click composing, joining a set, selecting presets with ⇉, a mark against text, a deferring pick, a class diagram link tooltip and the refusals ¬ ⇉, ¬⇉, ⇉⫽ and ⫽↳.
Round 1: a tooltip of marks alone published its deferral with an empty title, [↳ S](a.md#s "").
Round 1 Gantt check: Mermaid's gantt grammar reads no tooltip and no short form, yet pf read both.
Round 2: a Gantt click carrying a link target or ending in a semicolon was still compiled, though Mermaid cannot parse it.
Round 2: the click directive refusals and the operator target refusals had no test or fixture naming the click.
